title: WRF reference manifest
description: What the matched comparison was made against: which WRF executable, from which build recipe, under which namelists, producing which output bytes. Certification refuses to return a verdict while any of the four hash groups is absent. The reference wrfouts and the meteorological inputs are not redistributable; only their hashes appear here.

wrf_version.description: the released WRF version the reference binary was built from

wrf_commit.description: upstream commit of that build, where one is recorded

config_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the ArWen configuration this reference is the counterpart of; the manifest is addressed by configuration identity, never by a case name

wrf_exe_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the wrf.exe bytes that produced the reference stream

build_recipe_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the committed build-recipe document beside this manifest

namelist_sha256.description: file name -> SHA-256 for every namelist the reference run consumed (namelist.wps and namelist.input at minimum)

reference_wrfout_sha256.description: frame name -> SHA-256 for every reference wrfout frame the comparison scored

build_recipe.description: path, relative to this directory, of the committed build recipe

namelists.description: file name -> path, relative to this directory, of each committed namelist

unmeasured.description: for each hash group this manifest does not yet carry, why. A manifest that carries this block is refused by certify; the block exists so the refusal is legible rather than mysterious.
